data.long_meaning: Atrish is a name derived from Sanskrit language. The name Atrish is composed of two words - 'Atra' meaning truth, and 'ish' meaning God. The name signifies the truth that is revealed by God. The name Atrish carries the meaning “God's Truth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Atrish usually hope their child will grow to embody god's truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atrish total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
